issues.description: The listObjects() method calls imageMetadataRepository.findAll() inside the stream map closure, once per blob item. This is an N+1 query anti-pattern: if the container has N blobs, N full-table database queries are executed. Performance degrades linearly with the number of stored objects. The metadata should be fetched once before the stream and collected into a Map<String, ImageMetadata> keyed by S3Key for O(1) lookup per blob.

The getObject() method uses a background download thread and silently swallows all exceptions in its catch block with no logging or error propagation. If the blob download fails (e.g., network error, missing blob), the PipedOutputStream is closed silently, causing the PipedInputStream returned to the caller to raise an IOException with no diagnostic context. At minimum the exception should be logged.
